# Bundles — ready to list

Each bundle is a finished listing: one **ZIP** to upload as the product file, two **images**, and
**listing copy**. Generated by `../build_bundles.py` (re-run after changing any product).

| Folder | Bundle | Price (anchor) | Contains | Upload as product file |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rental-investor/` | Rental Investor Bundle | $39 ($58) | Short-Term Rental + Rental Property | `rental-investor-bundle.zip` |
| `self-employed/` | Self-Employed Bundle | $39 ($58) | Online Seller + Freelancer | `self-employed-bundle.zip` |
| `everything/` | Everything Bundle | $69 ($220) | All 10 trackers | `everything-bundle.zip` |

Each folder has:
- `*-bundle.zip` — the product file (all member trackers + setup guides + a Read-Me index)
- `hero.png` — main listing image (2000×2000)
- `included.png` — "what's inside" image (2000×2000)
- `listing-copy.md` — titles, tags, description, price

## To list one (same flow as a single product — see `../HOW-TO-LIST.md`)
1. New product on Gumroad/Etsy.
2. Upload the **`.zip`** as the digital file (one file covers the whole bundle).
3. Upload `hero.png` first, then `included.png` (add individual product heroes if you want more photos).
4. Paste title/tags/description from `listing-copy.md`; set the price.
5. Publish. On Etsy, keep the AI-disclosure line and list under "Designed by."

**Tip:** make the **Everything Bundle** your featured/pinned listing — it's the best value and the
highest-AOV sale.
